about_the_game:
The demo for Deathplane allows you to play through the first world of the game. The demo differs from the full game in the following ways:

  • Certain features, such as native Steam Input support, are not implemented yet and may be added in demo updates

  • Steam Achievements cannot be received

  • Any and all collectibles are not saved nor tracked

  • Story content is missing

As the demo represents a pre-launch state, many things, such as gameplay and balance, may be changed as development progresses. There may also be several bugs that will be patched in later updates to the demo or full release.
